categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Haid Group primarily operates in the animal husbandry and aquaculture sectors, focusing on feed production and sales, animal breeding (including high-quality aquatic and livestock breeds), animal health products, and integrated farming operations such as pig and aquatic product farming. The company’s business covers the entire value chain from R&D, design, production, sales to technical services. Key segments include feed, breeding stock, animal health (vaccines, veterinary drugs, biological products), livestock farming, and aquatic farming.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced animal nutrition and feed formulation technologies, supported by a large R&D team of over 3,500 professionals. It employs centralized raw material procurement combined with localized production near major farming regions. The firm uses microbial fermentation feed technology and antibiotic alternatives in feed, and factory-based aquaculture with controlled environments and biosecurity measures. It also applies SAP and EPS systems for efficient operations and risk management, and uses futures and hedging for raw material price risk control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haid Group serves a broad customer base including commercial livestock and aquaculture farmers, large-scale integrated farms, and distributors. Its products cater to pig, poultry (chicken, duck, goose), fish, shrimp, crab, and ruminant farming. The company also supplies large restaurant chains and fresh food platforms with processed aquatic products. Customers are primarily in the agriculture and aquaculture industries, with a focus on professional and scale farming operations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with major production and sales in South China, East China, Central China, and North China. It has expanded internationally with production and sales facilities in Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, Bangladesh), Africa (Egypt), South America (Ecuador), and Kazakhstan. Overseas markets are growing rapidly, with local production and tailored products to meet regional needs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Haid Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the animal husbandry supply chain. It produces feed and breeding stock (midstream), provides animal health products and technical services, and engages in livestock and aquatic farming (downstream). The company integrates upstream raw material procurement with downstream farming and product sales, offering comprehensive solutions to farmers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on technological innovation in animal nutrition, breeding, and health to enhance product competitiveness and farming efficiency. R&D priorities include precise nutrition databases for aquatic species, disease resistance nutrition systems, integrated breeding systems for shrimp and fish, and development of functional feeds and additives. It invests heavily in R&D annually, emphasizing rapid technology transfer and sustainable farming models. International expansion and digital transformation are also key strategic directions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales including animal feed, breeding stock, animal health products, and farmed livestock and aquatic products. The company also earns income from raw material trading and provides technical and farming services. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels, with some processed aquatic products sold to food service chains. The company also benefits from government subsidies and financial instruments related to hedging activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haid Group is positioned as a leading high-tech agricultural and animal husbandry company in China, with a strong market share in feed production and integrated farming solutions. It competes with other large feed and farming enterprises domestically and internationally. The company’s competitive advantages lie in its comprehensive product portfolio, advanced R&D capabilities, extensive service network, and international presence. Industry consolidation and technological innovation are intensifying competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 116.1 billion, representing a 10.89% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 2.74 billion, a 7.31% decrease due to losses in farming operations. The company has completed a strategic layout of 40 million tons of feed production capacity and continues to expand sales volume and market share domestically and overseas. Cash flow from operations increased significantly, reflecting strong business scale and growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangdong Haid Group emphasizes creating value for customers through superior product performance, comprehensive integrated solutions, and advanced technical services. Its products offer high survival rates, growth efficiency, and cost-effectiveness, helping farmers achieve better profitability and risk control. The company’s 'golden triangle' of feed, breeding stock, and animal health products, combined with scientific farming guidance, differentiates it from competitors. Its strong R&D and supply chain management enable rapid adaptation to market and environmental changes.
